detail: The calendar never depletes stock: Kukawa reads '329 + 0' on Aug 5 AND Aug 12; Askira '38 + 0' twice; Mafa '282 + 0' twice. The same cartons cover successive distributions, so the calendar marks Kukawa Aug 5 'covered' while the cover table says it RUNS DRY Aug 5.
fix_recommendation: Compute ON HAND + INBOUND as a running balance decremented by each preceding distribution at that site, from the same ledger the cover table uses.

detail: Every one of the 22 rows shows inbound '+ 0'. The page's own subtitle promises 'Inbound supply against the distributions you have planned' and the inbound half is empty everywhere.
fix_recommendation: Seed in-transit consignments to partner sites so inbound is exercised.

detail: MUAC bands carry the entire clinical claim and are never defined: no legend, axis, threshold label or unit. Geometry verified clinically correct to 0.5mm — the failure is legibility, not arithmetic.
fix_recommendation: Add a band key (red <115 / amber 115-124 / green >=125 mm), draw the two thresholds as labelled rules, mark each visit as a point.

detail: Narration says the MUAC climbs 'across their visits'; the plotted lines are perfectly straight two-point interpolations with zero vertices and no point markers.
fix_recommendation: Generate a non-linear per-visit series and render visit markers.

detail: Modal titled 'Batch LOT2604A' (batch scope) shows only ONE distribution; the table behind it proves LOT2604A also fed Dikwa (177 children). 'the distributions it supplied' is plural.
fix_recommendation: Resolve the batch to every distribution it fed, with a per-leg rollup.

detail: Narration promises ONE child's arc; the modal presents 13 identically-weighted rows in random order with no selection or highlight, the 6th sliced by the footer and 7 more below the fold.
fix_recommendation: Give the list a focused/selected child state with a full-size labelled chart; script the scene to open the strongest arc.

detail: Eleven identical solid-green 'Raise a shortfall' primary buttons are the highest-contrast column, out-weighting the cover figures. Monguno at 6 weeks shouts as loudly as Biu at 0.
fix_recommendation: Demote to a ghost/secondary control; reserve the filled primary for rows below the triage threshold.

detail: Kukawa already holds an open shortfall (raised Jul 23) yet its row still offers an identical 'Raise a shortfall' button with no state reflected, inviting a duplicate.
fix_recommendation: Reflect open-shortfall state in the row.

detail: No as-of stamp anywhere on a screen made entirely of projected dates, so a day-count claim cannot be verified even in principle. Narration's 'eleven days' resolves to 9 on screen.
fix_recommendation: Stamp 'as of <date>' on the cover card and render RUNS DRY with its day count.

detail: '9 of 13 children in the recorded sample were discharged as recovered' sits under '...to 314 children'. A reader computes 69% and reads it as the batch rate; it is a 4% subsample with no stated basis.
fix_recommendation: State the sampling basis beside the figure.

detail: 'ARRIVED ON' column holds shipment identifiers (SHP-2026-0101), not dates, beside a real date column.
